items.headline: Rams spoil the first-ever Thanksgiving Eve game, 26-13
items.body: The NFL's first Thanksgiving Eve game — and its first game ever on Netflix — belonged to the Rams, who ground out a 26-13 win over the Packers at SoFi Stadium. Running back Blake Corum was the whole show, rumbling for 184 yards, while Jordan Love had a night to forget with two interceptions.
items.say: Did you catch that Netflix game last night? The Rams ran all over the Packers — some guy named Blake Corum went for 184 rushing yards. Football the night before Thanksgiving is kind of great. You watching any today?

links.text: Corum powers L.A. on Thanksgiving Eve (Yahoo Sports)

items.headline: Turkey, then football — three games on the menu today
items.body: The day's main event (besides the bird): Bears at Lions kicks off the afternoon, Eagles at Cowboys is the mid-day main course, and the nightcap is a beauty — Chiefs at Bills, aka Patrick Mahomes vs. Josh Allen, a rivalry that always delivers. Couch, blanket, repeat.
items.say: The Thanksgiving football's on all day — Bears-Lions, Eagles-Cowboys, then Mahomes and the Chiefs at Josh Allen's Bills tonight. Perfect nap-and-football day. You hosting, or just showing up for the food and the games?

links.text: Full Thanksgiving schedule & how to watch (CBS Sports)

items.headline: Champions League chaos — Lille stun Bayern, Man United throw away a lead
items.body: Wednesday's Champions League slate was wild. Lille pulled off the shock of the night, coming from behind to beat mighty Bayern Munich 2-1, while Manchester United let a lead slip in a frantic 2-2 draw at Sporting. Liverpool, at least, kept it simple with a tidy 3-0 win at Club Brugge.
items.say: The Champions League had some chaos last night — little Lille knocked off Bayern, and Man United threw away another lead. Those midweek European nights never disappoint. You follow it at all?

links.text: Man United draw, Bayern & PSG drop points (Yahoo Sports)

items.headline: Wemby drops 44 — but the Blazers steal it in Portland
items.body: Victor Wembanyama was a monster with 44 points and 16 rebounds, but it still wasn't enough: Deni Avdija poured in 33 as the Trail Blazers edged the Spurs 116-111. Elsewhere, LeBron James turned back the clock with a 25-10-12 triple-double to lead the Sixers past the Heat, and the Knicks blew out the Cavs 121-102.
items.say: Wembanyama went for 44 and 16 last night and still lost — the guy is unreal to watch. And LeBron had a triple-double at his age. You keeping up with the NBA this year?

items.headline: A first in 100 years — the Macy's Parade is pushed to Saturday
items.body: Big one: for the first time in its 100-year history, the Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade has been postponed. A powerful storm with heavy rain and 40-mph wind gusts moved the whole thing — balloons, floats and all — to Saturday morning. So no giant Snoopy over Herald Square today; it's now set for 8:30 a.m. ET Saturday on NBC.
items.say: Did you hear the Macy's parade got postponed to Saturday? First time in a hundred years — this storm is no joke. Feels so weird not having it on this morning. You usually watch the parade?

links.text: Parade moved to Saturday over storm threat (CNN)

items.headline: Vinyl heaven — Record Store Day Black Friday lands tomorrow
items.body: Tomorrow isn't just Black Friday — it's Record Store Day Black Friday, when indie shops get a wave of exclusive vinyl. This year's crate includes limited pressings from Florence + the Machine and Noah Kahan, plus a long-lost 1975 Bruce Springsteen live album. A fun excuse to go flip through some records.
items.say: Tomorrow's Record Store Day Black Friday — all those exclusive vinyl drops at the local record shop. There's even an old live Springsteen album coming out. You still buy records, or all streaming these days?

links.text: Noah Kahan — Stick Season (Official Music Video)

items.headline: The Soul Train Awards are back — after three years away
items.body: One for the music fans: the Soul Train Awards return Friday night on BET and CBS after a three-year hiatus, taped in Chicago with Anthony Anderson hosting. Kehlani, whose sultry hit 'Folded' is up for R&B/Soul Song of the Year, headlines a stacked list of nominees.
items.say: The Soul Train Awards are back on Friday after being gone a few years — Anthony Anderson's hosting. If you haven't heard Kehlani's song 'Folded,' it's so good. You into R&B at all?

links.text: Soul Train Awards return to BET & CBS (TheWrap)

items.headline: Bah, humbug — Johnny Depp goes full Scrooge in 'Ebenezer'
items.body: If you want a dark, moody holiday watch, Johnny Depp's first big studio movie in years is in theaters: 'Ebenezer,' a horror-tinged spin on 'A Christmas Carol' from director Ti West, with Depp as a creepier-than-usual Scrooge and Ian McKellen as Marley's ghost. A Christmas classic with the lights turned way down.
items.say: There's a spooky new take on A Christmas Carol out — Johnny Depp as Scrooge, done almost like a horror movie. Looks wild. You a 'Christmas Carol every year' person, or does that feel too far?

links.text: Depp goes full Scrooge for Ti West (Empire)
